name: Memes
creator: NanoKVM Community
desc: Animated memes: Bad Apple, Nyan Cat, Peanut Butter Jelly Time and more. Tap for the next one.

MEMES.label: Memes to play
MEMES.description: Optional. Meme ids in play order, for example: nyan-cat, pbj-time, dvd-bounce. Prefix an id with - to leave it out (-bad-apple). Empty plays all.

MEME_AUTOPLAY.label: Autoplay (seconds)
MEME_AUTOPLAY.description: Move to the next meme after this many seconds. 0 stays on one meme until you tap.

MEME_SHUFFLE.label: Shuffle
MEME_SHUFFLE.description: on to play the memes in random order.

MEME_TITLES.label: Show titles
MEME_TITLES.description: on shows each meme's name for two seconds when it starts.
